corrections_this_cycle: The first draft of this report claimed 'no prior manual-method report exists — this is the first 5-query WebSearch pass.' That was wrong: four prior runs exist on this exact panel (2026-05-06, 07-05, 08-05, 09-05). The draft therefore reported a flat 'never cited' baseline and MISSED a 2-point regression and the loss of two specific blog citations. Root cause: the run read only the most recent file in data/aeo-citations/ (2026-11-03, the 12-query SerpAPI series) and never read state.json or activity-log.md, so the panel's own history was invisible. Corrected before final push.

The first draft's 'NEW competitors' table was built from a domain-string diff only — the exact error the 09-05 standing lesson warns about. Re-diffed by company NAME as well as domain; in this instance all six survived, but the check was added, not assumed.

STANDING LESSON REINFORCED: read state.json and activity-log.md BEFORE writing the report, not after. The panel history, the carried-over pending actions, and the prior cycle's cited URLs all live there and none of them are recoverable from the report directory alone.
